option_relations.rationale: Exophiala xenobiotica keratitis is a specific type of fungal keratitis, and the provided leaf ID B3.1 directly corresponds to this condition.
Corneal melanoma is a distinct condition unrelated to the fungal keratitis described in the leaf ID B3.1.
Corneal melanin deposition from topical epinephrine is unrelated to the fungal keratitis described in the leaf ID B3.1.
Prior pine processionary infection is a separate condition and not directly related to the fungal keratitis described in the leaf ID B3.1.
Keratitis by more common Exophiala species is a broader category that includes Exophiala xenobiotica keratitis, as described in leaf ID B3.1.
None is not a valid medical condition and is unrelated to the fungal keratitis described in the leaf ID B3.1.
